competences.description: Attacks the enemy with claws and disturbs the enemy's HP recovery for 1 turn. The damage of this attack increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.

competences.description: Recovers the HP of all allies by 20% each and increases their Attack Speed for 2 turns. In addition, decreases the chances of allies receiving Critical Hits for 2 turns.
Attacks an enemy 3 times. Each attack has a 45% chance to decrease the enemy's Defense for 3 turns. The damage of this attack increases according to your MAX HP.
